budget.rationale: The five category targets reconcile exactly to $11,420–$14,720, but flights, lodging, and vehicle inventory remain unquoted June 2027 proxies. The medium-confidence band sits within $280 of the preferred maximum, so the rubric caps Budget at 2/5 until a high-confidence reconciliation is available.

weather.rationale: The South Coast plan is intrinsically exposed to cool, wet, and windy conditions even in June. The 45–58°F planning range was not independently regenerated from a station-normal table in this audit, so the adverse classification is credible but remains medium confidence.

fireRisk.rationale: Very low is the safety rating (5/5), corresponding to a <2% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Iceland has had rare large grass fires, but its maritime climate, sparse tree cover, and limited fire history make wildfire a very small June travel risk. Volcanic hazards remain important, but they stay in the separate general Risk axis.

swim.rationale: The score is correctly based on geothermal swimming, not 50–52°F ocean water. Reykjavík officially lists 82–90°F family pools and 100–111°F hot tubs, and the itinerary schedules several heated soaks.

variety.rationale: The itinerary strongly schedules waterfalls, glacier walking, black beaches, lagoons, geothermal pools, city/harbor, and volcanic landscapes.

ease.rationale: One car and no planned mid-trip flight help, but four lodging bases, three moves, and the long Höfn-to-west reposition create moderate deterministic load (3/5).

food.rationale: Current Bónus/Krónan operator locators and the official Vatnajökull regional guide independently confirm discount groceries in Reykjavík, Vík, Höfn, and Reykjanes/Keflavík. Remote days still require packed food, strongly supporting the bounded 3/5 rather than a higher score.

risk.rationale: Exact June 2027 PIT–KEF nonstop operation is unverified, but a one-stop backup exists. South Coast wind/road conditions, Reynisfjara sneaker waves, and Reykjanes volcanic change are real and require daily official checks.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights derive 5/5 under the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Iceland does not overlap the documented visited-place list, deriving 5/5.

pto.rationale: Eight PTO days derive 3/5 under the slider rubric and have zero default weight.
